title: The Best Wi-Fi Presence Sensors
subtitle: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth mmWave presence sensors, including Home Assistant favorites, ranked.
intro: We pulled the Wi-Fi presence sensors on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: zones, local Home Assistant support, and extra sensors.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: Aqara FP2
awards.why: Up to 5 people, multiple zones, and fall detection, with 2,526 reviews.

awards.label: Best for Home Assistant
awards.name: AKAMATIS Presence Sensor v2.2
awards.why: A plug-and-play ESPHome presence sensor for $20.99.

systems_note: The Akamatis sensors and LD2410C modules run ESPHome and work only with Home Assistant. SwitchBot's sensor is Bluetooth and reaches Wi-Fi through a SwitchBot hub.

products.name: Aqara Presence Sensor FP2, mmWave Radar Wired Smart Motion Sensor
products.verdict: The most capable presence sensor: zones, up to five people, and fall detection.

products.name: AKAMATIS Human Presence Sensor v2.2 for Home Assistant, mmWave Radar Smart Motion Sensor, Adjustable Sensitivity, WiFi (Seeed C3, External Antenna + LD2410B) (White, 1 Pack (Sensor Only))
products.verdict: A ready-made ESPHome presence sensor for Home Assistant, with an external antenna.
pros: Plug and play with Home Assistant

products.name: SwitchBot Smart mmWave Radar Motion Sensor, Bluetooth Presence Sensor with Dynamic Detection & Zone Positioning, Compatible with Alexa, HomeKit & Apple Home (Presence Sensor*1)
products.verdict: A battery presence sensor with zones, for SwitchBot homes.
cons: Bluetooth; needs a SwitchBot hub for remote use

products.name: Akamatis Human Presence & Light Sensor Litos v3, mmWave Smart Motion Sensor, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Adjustable Sensitivity, Requires Home Assistant (White, 1 Pack)
products.verdict: Akamatis's newer sensor adds a proper ambient light sensor.

products.name: 3pcs LD2410C Human Presence Radar Sensor Module HLK-LD2410 LD2410 Millimeter Wave Non-Contact 24GHz ISM Band Serial Port IO Level Output
products.verdict: Bare radar modules for building your own ESPHome sensors.
cons: Bare modules; you need an ESP32 and wiring

buyers_guide.a: A motion sensor (PIR) sees movement, so lights turn off if you sit still. An mmWave presence sensor detects breathing-level motion, so it knows you're still in the room while you read or work.
Most mmWave sensors need USB or wall power because the radar runs constantly. A few newer battery models combine PIR and mmWave to save power.

buyers_guide.q: Can it tell where I am in the room?
buyers_guide.a: Some models, like the Aqara FP2, support zones, so a desk, couch, and bed can trigger different automations.
